section.title: The accountant: 11 November
items: About 84.0M tokens, 5.3M of them not cache reads, about $46 (10 November: 47.4M, 3.4M, about $27). The costliest: the dashboard ($9.40, 2 wakes), the watcher ($9.18, 4 wakes), your conductor ($8.85, 4 wakes), vault ($5.68). Every wake reported quality pass.

The rise is cache writes, not models: 5.1M against 3.3M. The watcher's cache writes nearly doubled (1.29M against 0.66M) on the same four routine Opus wakes, and its Sonnet change has still not been made. The dashboard's first wake (01:23, your ask) was its biggest: 9.1M tokens on Opus, with 15 Sonnet sub-agent calls beside it.

Advice: the watcher to Sonnet first (8 routine wakes in two days, all pass); vault to Sonnet, not Haiku, now that it drains again (aebc7387; both drains empty, pass); the dashboard and your writer to Sonnet; dev and crm stay on Opus for now (one wake each, real work); your conductor stays on Opus (Dinis's direction), but its sub-agents (this accountant, the reviewer) can run on Sonnet. You decide, and change the model in each agent's session.
No line on 11 November from the designer, the helper or automation: they committed nothing that day.
